## Method and comparison

- Actual staked alpha = `sum(TotalHotkeyAlpha(hotkey, netuid))`.
- Pending alpha = `PendingServerEmission + PendingValidatorEmission + PendingRootAlphaDivs + PendingOwnerCut + PendingBasketDeposits`.
- Calculated staked alpha = `SubnetAlphaOut - AlphaBurned - pending alpha - SubnetProtocolAlpha`.
- Signed discrepancy Δ = `actual staked alpha - calculated staked alpha`.
- 720-block normalized movement = `abs(long movement) × 720 / long interval blocks`.
- The noise reference is the largest raw movement in `mainnet-alpha-accounting-two-tempos-report.md`: 0.000021877 α over 720 blocks.

This two-snapshot comparison includes ordinary extrinsics and the runtime-447 transition. Normalization tests whether the long-run accumulation rate is noticeably greater; it does not prove which individual transition produced each rao.
